name: Brushing and Linking with Hilbert Codes
aliases: Brushing and Linking for DVL and 3D Views
definition: A technique connecting 1D and 3D views by using Hilbert codes as selection ranges for Regions of Interest (ROIs).
summary: Brushing and Linking with Hilbert Codes connects 1D views to 3D volume rendering by mapping selections to Hilbert code ranges, enabling compact highlighting of non-contiguous regions.
